# Deletion Criteria for Auto-Generated Skills

## Identification

Skills auto-generated by system tooling carry this frontmatter marker:

    metadata:
      hermes:
        generated_by: <system>

Both nested and flattened YAML forms mean the same thing.

## Deletion Criteria

Delete when ALL of these are true:
1. `metadata.hermes.generated_by` is set (check BOTH nested and flattened YAML forms)
2. The skill is a thin wrapper around a single tool call
3. The skill duplicates functionality available through the base tool directly

Do NOT delete if the skill has been substantially hand-edited beyond the template.

## How to Check

Scan with: `find ~/.hermes/skills -name "SKILL.md" -exec grep -l "generated_by" {} \;`
Then verify with `yaml.safe_load`. Check nested form:
`fm.get("metadata", {}).get("hermes", {}).get("generated_by")`
Never rely on substring search alone.
